decision.reason: [ev-e2dcb3e0ebe6] clearly states the subject and change: composite resources (XRs) lose native connection details support, while managed resources keep `writeConnectionSecretToRef`. It also states what operators must do: compose their own connection details Secret. However, the excerpt does not name the XR-side field, XRD setting or Composition construct that shows an environment uses native XR connection details, so the only open aspect, applicability, cannot be written as a declarative condition from this text. The specifics are deferred to the connection details composition guide, which is not shown. That guide, or the v2 API or schema diff for XR and XRD connection-secret fields, is needed.
